topic: Campaign build-out per human order: 8+ maps, each BIGGER than 84x84, with boss fights; choose the architecture
context: HUMAN DIRECTIVE (2026-11-10 07:51, verbatim): 'use collective consile and make multiple maps bigger. a whole ass compain with boss etc... the first map should be super easy and it is actually impossible'. Clarified with the human at 07:53: campaign = 8+ maps (not 3 or 5); 'actually impossible' = map 1 is currently broken/unwinnable for the player and must be fixed AND made super easy.

EVIDENCE FILE: .council/evidence/survey-architecture.md (read-only code survey with file:line refs + renderer memory measurement). Headlines: the game is exactly one hand-authored 84x84 map (defs.py:5, anchors mapgen.py:12-17, leaks into app.py:89/236/866, ai.py:167, render.py:43-46); the title already HAS a Campaign button that silently runs the same single mission (ui.py:242-244, app.py:437-438); there is no progression, no scenario config and no file writes anywhere (app.py:265-272); a boss already exists (hollow-king, defs.py:145-150, wake logic ai.py:176-200) and waves already escalate (ai.py:109-141).

MEASURED SIZE CONSTRAINT: Renderer pre-bakes one full-map SRCALPHA surface ((W+H)*32+...)^2 -> 84x84 = ~131MB, 104x104 = ~196MB, 128x128 = ~292MB, 150x150 = ~407MB (render.py:43-52). So 'bigger' is quadratic in renderer memory; 104-128 tiles is the measured safe band without rewriting the renderer to chunked baking. Pathfinding is not the bottleneck (array A*, 77fps at 115 units, recorded on this bus 04:08).

SCOPE IMPLICATION: this reverses design lock DESIGN.md:22 ('One map, fully dressed') and needs new code (campaign module, mapgen parameterization, mission-select UI, local save). Engine = deepseek owns; QA harness + balance = mimo owns (collaboration.md table). Therefore: shared scope decision -> council, not solo.

REVERSIBILITY: scenario table + campaign.py + a menu branch; mission 1 can be the existing Ashen Vale layout unchanged, so a one-commit revert returns the game to today's single map. No asset or audio changes required by any option.

CURRENT TUNING MACHINERY: difficulty tiers squire/knight/warlord (defs.py:438-451) scale enemy hp/dmg (world.py:170-174), AI income (ai.py:41), first wave (ai.py:35), wave size (ai.py:113), cap (ai.py:57,116,148); starting resources from difficulty (world.py:99-100). Default CLI difficulty is squire (app.py:1018). Two dead knobs exist that a campaign could own: generate_map(difficulty=...) is never read (mapgen.py:84) and the tier key 'speed' has no consumer anywhere.

EXISTING HARD-DIFFICULTY EVIDENCE (mimo's own balance runs, 3x, commit a7c3cc6 and design/notes): the Knight-tier hero dies inside wave 1 at 5:37-5:39. Fresh autoplay runs at all three tiers (headless, 1 run each) are being collected into .council/evidence/difficulty-map1.md before resolution - that file will state whether ANY tier is currently winnable by autoplay on the base map.

CONSTRAINTS: mission 1 must be 'impossible to lose' while still teaching build/gather/fight; skirmish must keep its three tiers (mimo owns balance); whatever mechanism wins should be data-driven so later campaign maps can ramp difficulty without new code.
